interpretation: Projection of deposited effect-allele frequencies onto the fixed 1000 Genomes superpopulation panel; not automatically participant-ancestry fractions or meta-analysis weights.

benchmark.name: Yengo 2022 ancestry-stratified height EAF benchmark
benchmark.verdict_rule: Each of the five ancestry-specific analyses must return status=estimated and rank its predeclared corresponding 1000G superpopulation first. The pooled analysis is excluded.

panel.source: 1000 Genomes phase 3 (20130502) super-population ALT frequencies at HapMap3 sites

study.expectation_basis: same-paper ancestry-specific analysis; AFR is the predeclared top rank

panel_confusability.note: identifiability is determined from population-frequency contrasts on the matched variants; raw pairwise AF correlations are descriptive because their shared baseline can be misleading

decomposition.uncertainty_note: delete-one-chromosome jackknife conditions on the fixed panel; it omits target and reference allele-frequency sampling uncertainty and model misspecification
decomposition.acceptance_gate_note: count, chromosome-coverage, contrast-rank, condition-number, and fit cutoffs are engineering gates, not calibrated statistical thresholds
